hebrewText: חִגְר֨וּ וְ/סִפְד֜וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֗ים הֵילִ֨ילוּ֙ מְשָׁרְתֵ֣י מִזְבֵּ֔חַ בֹּ֚אוּ לִ֣ינוּ בַ/שַּׂקִּ֔ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֖י אֱלֹהָ֑/י כִּ֥י נִמְנַ֛ע מִ/בֵּ֥ית אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם מִנְחָ֥ה וָ/נָֽסֶךְ

tokens.bdb: to gird on (as a belt, armor, etc.)
tokens.kjv: be able to put on, be afraid, appointed, gird, restrain, [idiom] on every side.

tokens.bdb: properly, to tear the hair and beat the breasts (as Orientals do in grief); generally to lament; by implication, to wail
literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
tokens.kjv: chief ruler, [idiom] own, priest, prince, principal officer.

tokens.bdb: to howl (with a wailing tone) or yell (with a boisterous one)
to attend as a menial or worshipper; figuratively, to contribute to

tokens.bdb: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.
tokens.explanation: bo — vir, ir, entrar, chegar, avançar em direção a algo

tokens.bdb: to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain)
tokens.kjv: abide (all night), continue, dwell, endure, grudge, be left, lie all night, (cause to) lodge (all night, in, -ing, this night), (make to) murmur, remain, tarry (all night, that night).

tokens.bdb: properly, a mesh (as allowing a liquid to run through), i.e. coarse loose cloth or sacking (used in mourning and for bagging); hence, a bag (for grain, etc.)
